name: Patch
description: Patch screens for your stage boxes: tap a socket to name it and choose the channel, control group or mix it's patched to. Imports DiGiCo sessions, LV1 sessions and dLive shows. A card on FOH Home finds where anything is patched.
author: JPMixer

settings.label: Lock the patch
settings.help: Anyone can open the Patch page, but nobody can change it. Handy during a service.

settings.label: Show the patch on FOH Home
settings.help: A card with how many sockets are patched, any channel patched from two sockets or needing 48V the console has off, and a box to find where a channel or socket is patched.
